limitations: Optional self-hosted TimelineJS 3.9.13 renders one frozen selected-narrative projection with at most 100 eligible events. Unknown/relative/position-only events remain omitted under the existing adapter; JSON exports retain all eligible events beyond the renderer limit.

Renderer is an opaque allow-scripts-only iframe. It receives only whitelisted presentation fields, never the complete companion or evidence graph. Strict child CSP blocks external fetch/media/frames; a self-contained shell with exact script hashes, embedded styles/icon font and system text fonts removes CDN/font/spreadsheet dependencies. No application analytics IDs or tracking events enabled. Cloudflare may append edge scripts; owned HTML bytes and exact child script hashes are checked, and isolated replay verifies edge scripts are blocked.

Root CSP adds same-origin frames and data fonts; other directives/allowlists remain unchanged. Beginning/latest, keyboard navigation, fallback event list, stale unmount and retry are tested. Representative visual review is not exhaustive accessibility certification.

No persisted field, API, migration, auth or size-limit change. Public publication/revocation endpoints and richer revision/composite/plan/comparison snapshots remain pending; TL-17 and TL-04 remain partial.

visual.limitations: Representative same-event desktop/mobile light/dark captures only. Prior toolbar overlap, dark axis and selected-marker contrast blockers are cleared. Event text, assessment, selected marker, controls and fallback disclosure are readable. Mobile timeline group text is partly covered by the event marker; edge tick labels are clipped by the panning viewport. A floating widget touches the lower-right outer edge without obscuring navigation actions. Long content, dense timelines, expanded fallback states and measured contrast or exhaustive accessibility certification are outside this visual review.
